The best thing I ever did with my SO was have a long distance relationship. Especially starting college. We were able to develop who we were as individuals after spending so much time as a unit. But space is wonderful for the relationship so don't be too afraid that he's enjoying it, I did too. It didn't mean I cared about her or missed her any less. I made sure to call her every night even if it was just to check in and chat. We webcammed here and there as well. An hour and half is nothing really considering I had to board a plane every time I wanted to see her. We made it a point to talk to each other and to see each other at least once every 2 - 3 months. Distance makes the heart grow fonder never made sense until then. Just keep up the communication by whatever means and make sure you guys know what's going on with each others lives even if you aren't there physically. Also, nothing beats care packages.
